card.text: Explore Adelheid in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 189 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction, 104 ± 11 km volume-equivalent diameter. Both pole solutions remain possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 189 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 52 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
